input: Get a skin cancer screening this summer

gold.taskTitle: Get a Skin Cancer Screening This Summer
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and complete a skin cancer screening appointment during the summer season.

questions.title: Do you have a dermatologist you already see?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing dermatologist or needs to find a new one.

questions.title: What month do you want this done by?
questions.description: Identify the specific deadline or target month within summer for the screening.

questions.title: Has your primary care doctor referred you before?
questions.description: Find out if a referral is needed or has been obtained from a primary care physician.

questions.title: What is driving this screening — routine or a concern?
questions.description: Understand whether this is a routine annual check or prompted by a specific spot or symptom.

questions.title: Does your insurance cover dermatology visits?
questions.description: Clarify whether insurance coverage is known or needs to be verified before booking.

questions.title: Have you had a full-body screening done before?
questions.description: Determine the user's prior experience with skin cancer screenings to set expectations.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel for the appointment?
questions.description: Establish a geographic radius or preference for finding a suitable dermatologist or clinic.
